definitions.outbox_recovery_success_rate: accepted runs whose start_run Outbox was processed, Temporal Workflow completed, and Run reached a terminal completed state / accepted requests
definitions.lost_run_count: accepted requests missing any persisted message/run, processed start event, deterministic workflow start, or terminal run
definitions.duplicate_workflow_count: workflow_execution rows beyond one per run
definitions.backlog_drain_time_ms: monotonic elapsed time from replacement Worker readiness until all start events were processed and all runs completed
definitions.percentile_method: linear interpolation at (n-1)*q over successful requests
